channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: PGR denuncia blogueiro Oswaldo Eustáquio por associação criminosa
item.description: The Prosecutor General's Office denounced blogger Oswaldo Eustáquio, a Bolsonaro supporter living in exile in Spain, for criminal association based on social media posts and involvement in acts opposing Lula's 2022 inauguration. Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered Eustáquio to submit a preliminary defense within 15 days. Eustáquio claims political persecution and says Spain’s National Court ruled the matter as protected free speech.

item.title: g1 e GloboNews entrevistam nesta quinta-feira (6) Romeu Zema, candidato à Presidência da República
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's presidential candidate, will be interviewed on Thursday (6) by g1 and GloboNews as the second in a series that began with Renan Santos (Missão) on Wednesday and continues with Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) on Friday. Lula declined the invitation, and Flávio Bolsonaro has not yet confirmed for the Monday (10) interview. The interview will be conducted by journalists Andréia Sadi and Natuza Nery from 2:00 PM to 3:30 PM, broadcast live and simultaneously.

item.title: PSB e aliados fecham chapa majoritária de Simone Tebet em SP
item.description: The PSB has named Laio Moraes (PT) as first alternate and Marcelo Barbieri (PDT) as second alternate on Simone Tebet’s Senate ticket for São Paulo, strengthening a broad center-left front. The campaign says the composition aligns with commitments to democracy, social justice, and party unity. Meanwhile, Lula is also pushing for Marina Silva (REDE) to run in the same race, with both candidates splitting voter preference in recent polls.

item.title: Bolsa cai 0,09% com Copom no radar; dólar recua
item.description: The Ibovespa fell 0.09% and the dollar declined 0.06% as investors await the Copom decision, with expectations of a 0.25 percentage point Selic cut for the fourth consecutive time. The Genial/Quaest poll shows Lula leading Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 presidential race, albeit with a narrowed margin. Markets also reacted to signals of a U.S.-Iran agreement on maritime traffic in the Strait of Hormuz, weighing on oil prices.

item.title: Tabela do frete: Lula sanciona novas regras e define obrigatoriedade de preço mínimo, mas não fixa valores
item.description: President Lula signed a law making minimum freight payments mandatory for road transport, without setting specific values, leaving updates to the ANTT based on operational costs like fuel and tolls. The law introduces the CIOT, enforces penalties for non-compliance, and removed the proposed amnesty for truckers involved in 2022 protests. The Senate rejected a proposed R$ 5,000 monthly minimum wage for long-haul truckers as unconstitutional.

item.title: Acusação de estupro, 'arma contra Lulinha' e Arthur Lira mais perto do Senado: os impactos de Alfredo Gaspar como vice de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The selection of Alfredo Gaspar (PL) as vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) ticket aims to exploit the INSS scandal and investigations against Lulinha to weaken the Lula government. Gaspar, who served as rapporteur of the INSS CPMI, faces a criminal complaint alleging rape of a minor, which could harm the Bolsonaro campaign. His candidacy also clears the way for Arthur Lira (PP) to pursue a Senate seat in Alagoas, as both were competing for the same right-wing electorate.

item.title: Flávio usa broche de tesoura verde e amarela em anúncio de Gaspar
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro wore a green and yellow scissors brooch when announcing Alfredo Gaspar as his running mate in the PL presidential ticket, symbolizing his promised 'tesouraço' to cut taxes and bureaucracy. Gaspar was selected after other center-right options declined, with the decision reportedly made six months ago according to Valdemar Costa Neto.

item.title: Candidato do Missão, Renan Santos abre série de entrevistas do g1 e da GloboNews com presidenciáveis
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate of the Missão party, launched the series of interviews by g1 and GloboNews with presidential contenders on July 24. The commercial-free interview, conducted by journalists Andréia Sadi and Natuza Nery, lasted about 90 minutes. Lula (PT) declined to participate, while Romeu Zema (Novo), Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) have been scheduled for upcoming interviews.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Investigação sobre Lulinha derruba assessor do presidente
item.description: President Lula's aide, Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola, stepped down from the president's electoral campaign following an investigation into money received from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha. The decision was made amid suspicions surrounding the financial transaction.

item.title: Na Praia: fim de semana terá shows de Titãs, Paralamas, Nando Reis e Simone Mendes
item.description: The Na Praia 2026 festival, in its 10th edition, will take place on August 7, 8, and 9 in Brasília, featuring performances by Titãs (celebrating 40 years of 'Cabeça de Dinossauro'), Os Paralamas do Sucesso, Nando Reis, Simone Mendes, and Filho do Piseiro. The event blends music, gastronomy, sports, and family activities, including a special Father's Day program on Sunday.

item.title: Presidente do Republicanos nega ingerência sobre recursos de emendas parlamentares
item.description: The national president of the Republicans party, federal deputy Marcos Pereira (SP), denied any interference by the party presidency in the allocation of parliamentary amendments, stating that no quotas, reserves, financial limits, or other allocation mechanisms were ever assigned to his leadership. He submitted a statement to Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino to clarify the party's position.

item.title: “A regra vai ser prender ou matar”, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate of the Missão party, stated that if elected, he would order police to 'arrest or kill' criminals, including cell phone thieves, to ensure public security. He advocated for the use of force as state policy and cited Nayib Bukele as an inspiration, despite acknowledging that public security is under state governors, not the federal president. He also emphasized the role of the 'good father figure' in reducing youth crime.

item.title: Presidência: Cury anuncia mineiro Júlio Delgado como vice na chapa
item.description: Augusto Cury, the presidential candidate from the Avante party, announced former federal deputy Júlio Delgado as his running mate. The announcement was made via an open letter to the nation, with support from Avante's national president Luís Tibé, aiming to overcome political polarization. The ticket proposes three priority reforms: adopting a semi-presidentialist system, reforming the STF, and strengthening foreign policy.

item.title: Neutros, União Brasil e PP lideram tempo para propaganda de rádio e TV
item.description: The TSE has released the criteria for allocating free radio and TV advertising time for the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections, based on the size of party benches in the Chamber of Deputies. The União Progressista Federation (União Brasil and PP) leads with 104 deputies, followed by the PL with 98. The federation has declared neutrality in the election, while the PL nominated Flávio Bolsonaro as its candidate. Parties failing to meet the performance clause (2.5% of valid votes or 13 deputies elected in at least one-third of the states) are barred from free airtime and debate participation.

item.title: ESPECIAL: Natuza Nery e Andréia Sadi entrevistam Renan Santos - O Assunto #1776
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate of the Missão party, stated that if elected, he would not comply with monocratic decisions of the STF that he deems illegal, arguing that illegal decisions should not be obeyed. He also said he would be willing to negotiate with the Centrão, though he referred to its members as 'parasites,' and advocated a tough stance on crime inspired by Nayib Bukele, while clarifying he is not Bukele. On the economy, he described Brazil as facing a 'fiscal drama' and proposed decoupling the minimum wage from Social Security adjustments to control public spending.

item.title: Crusoé: O que Marcola vai ter de explicar
item.description: Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, known as Marcola and former chief of staff to President Lula, admitted receiving R$ 249,000 from Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of the president’s son, as a personal loan, stating he has already repaid the debt. However, the repayment does not rule out investigation, as experts indicate at least two potential crimes — such as money laundering and influence peddling — may be under scrutiny by authorities.

item.title: Augusto Cury escolhe ex-deputado como vice em chapa à Presidência
item.description: Psychiatrist and writer Augusto Cury announced former federal deputy Julio Delgado as his running mate in the presidential race under the Avante party. Delgado, elected six times between 2002 and 2023, previously belonged to MDB, PPS, PSB, and PV before joining Avante in 2024. Cury praised Delgado’s ethical record and anti-corruption stance, stating that if elected, Delgado would lead three reforms: establishing a semi-presidential system, instituting eight-year terms for STF justices, and transforming the foreign minister into a secretary of state.

item.title: Mais um recado de Carlos Bolsonaro para Michelle?
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), Senate candidate from Santa Catarina, mocked the selection of Senator Eduardo Girão as vice-presidential running mate for Romeu Zema in the 2026 presidential race. Until recently, Girão had been a pre-candidate for governor of Ceará, raising questions about his sudden shift in political strategy. The post implies Carlos Bolsonaro’s comment may be an indirect message to former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, though she is not explicitly named.

item.title: Michelle faltou a anúncio de vice de Flávio porque estava fazendo comida para Bolsonaro, diz Damares
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro missed the announcement of Flávio Bolsonaro's running mate for the 2026 presidential race because she was preparing food for former President Jair Bolsonaro, according to Senator Damares Alves. The event took place at the PL party headquarters in Brasília, where deputy Alfredo Gaspar was confirmed as the vice-presidential candidate. Michelle lives about 20 minutes from the venue.

item.title: Casado: Flávio Bolsonaro está isolado e escolha por Gaspar surpreende
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro arrived at the presidential campaign isolated, lacking significant support from his own party or radical right leaders, according to columnist Letícia Casado. The choice of Deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as running mate surprised the political class, as Gaspar is not a nationally recognized figure nor aligned with the main currents of bolsonarism. The decision was seen as either a waste of political capital or a sign of disorganization within the ticket.

item.title: Crises diplomáticas do Brasil com EUA e Argentina se agravam
item.description: Diplomatic relations between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) government and the United States under Donald Trump, as well as with Javier Milei's Argentina, deteriorated severely within 24 hours. This escalation comes at a critical juncture, just two months before Brazil's 2026 elections, raising concerns about potential impacts on trade alliances and geopolitical positioning.

item.title: Resultados das Eleições 2026 poderão ser acompanhados em tempo real
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will make available the 'Resultados' portal and mobile app for real-time tracking of the 2026 General Elections vote tally, starting at 5:00 p.m. Brasília time after polls close. Data will be updated as ballot booth reports are received and processed, enabling users to consult results by state, municipality, and office — including presidential votes cast in Brazil and abroad — for both the first round (October 4) and potential second round (October 25).

item.title: Alagoas: MDB lança Renan Filho ao governo e Calheiros ao Senado
item.description: The MDB launched Renan Filho as its candidate for governor of Alagoas and Renan Calheiros for Senate re-election, with the vice-governor position still undecided. The party is negotiating with the PT to include a petista on the ticket, while the opposition, led by JHC of the PSDB, is seeking a coalition with the União Progressista Federation following Gaspar's withdrawal.

item.title: PGR denuncia Oswaldo Eustáquio ao STF por associação criminosa em atos golpistas
item.description: The Attorney General’s Office filed a complaint before the Supreme Federal Court against blogger Oswaldo Eustáquio, a fugitive residing in Spain, for criminal association in anti-democratic acts. He is accused of participating in protests, encampments, and military-front mobilizations aimed at undermining the legitimacy of the electoral system and the Democratic State of Law, including social media posts and alleged presence at the Alvorada Palace in 2022. Spain denied his extradition in December 2025, citing lack of dual criminality and political motivation in the Brazilian investigation.

item.title: Saiba como consultar seu local de votação nas eleições de outubro
item.description: Voters across Brazil can now check their polling locations for the 2026 elections via the TSE website using CPF, mother’s name, and date of birth, or through the e-Título app. The first round is scheduled for October 4, with a potential runoff on October 25. The TRE of Rio de Janeiro has changed 66 electoral zones, affecting 188,000 voters in 20 municipalities, citing security concerns due to organized crime dominance in certain areas.

item.title: Bolsonaro pede a Moraes autorização para receber visita de Flávio e demais filhos no Dia dos Pais
item.description: Lawyers for Jair Bolsonaro requested STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes to authorize visits from his sons Flávio, Carlos, and Jair Renan on Father's Day, citing the exceptional nature of the date. The defense seeks to restore visits suspended after Flávio used a prior visit to promote Bolsonaro's voting request on social media, which Moraes deemed a misuse of visitation rights and a violation of judicial orders. Eduardo Bolsonaro is excluded as he is self-exiled in the U.S.

item.title: Racha entre PP e União Brasil ameaça palanque de Raquel Lyra em Pernambuco
item.description: The convention of the União Progressista Federation in Pernambuco ended without consensus on the coalition for Governor Raquel Lyra's (PSD) re-election bid, due to a split between PP and União Brasil in forming the ticket. Official support for the governor was postponed until the deadline, threatening the unity of her electoral slate. The decision remains pending, reflecting internal divisions within the allied base.

item.title: Brasil confirma que su embajador no regresará a Argentina hasta que cesen “los reiterados insultos y agresiones” de Milei
item.description: Brazil has decided to keep its ambassador in Argentina withdrawn and bilateral relations at the charge d'affaires level until Argentine President Javier Milei ceases his repeated insults and attacks against Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira stated the move is a direct response to Milei’s remarks, in which he called Lula a 'convict', 'corrupt', and 'socialist trash'. The Argentine government has not apologized, attributing the tensions to ideological differences.

item.title: A dois meses da eleição, Brasil enfrenta crises diplomáticas inéditas com EUA e Argentina
item.description: Two months ahead of the 2026 presidential elections, Brazil is facing an unprecedented diplomatic crisis with both the United States and Argentina, following the downgrade of relations with Buenos Aires and the revocation of the Brazilian ambassador’s visa in Washington by the Trump administration. The tensions stem from repeated attacks by Argentine President Javier Milei against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and the U.S.’s unilateral announcement of Daniel Perez as ambassador to Brasília without prior Brazilian agrément. Experts describe the situation as unprecedented due to the gravity and simultaneity of the events.

item.title: “Flávio perdeu a oportunidade de colocar uma mulher como vice”, diz Malafaia
item.description: Pastor Silas Malafaia criticized the choice of Alfredo Gaspar as running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro, saying the senator missed the opportunity to nominate a woman for the position. He noted that none of the main presidential candidates have a woman as vice president and argued this choice represents a lost chance to advance female representation in politics.

item.title: Debates das eleições 2026: veja calendário, datas e regras dos principais debates presidenciais
item.description: The schedule for the 2026 presidential debates is taking shape, with the first debate set for August 23, hosted by Band in partnership with TV Cultura, TV Gazeta, and Jovem Pan. Eleven candidates have so far declared their intention to run, but the final list will only be confirmed after the August 15 candidacy registration deadline. Lula (PT) said he will not attend debates if it's 'just to hear nonsense', while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated he will only participate if Lula is present.

item.title: Em entrevista a programa argentino, Mauro Vieira diz que questão ideológica é secundária
item.description: Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira stated in an interview with Argentine TV that Brazil's reduction of diplomatic relations with Argentina was a response to President Javier Milei's attacks on Lula, but that ideological considerations are secondary. He emphasized that Lula maintains good international relations regardless of the ruling party's color and that respect and education are fundamental to bilateral ties.

item.title: Nova lei cria rota turística entre Porto Alegre e Serra Gaúcha
item.description: Law 15.482/26 establishes the Vale da Felicidade Tourism Route, covering 20 municipalities between the Porto Alegre metropolitan region and the Serra Gaúcha, aiming to promote cultural, rural, historical, and adventure tourism. Originating from Bill 1028/22 by Deputy Osmar Terra (PL-RS), the law was signed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and published in the Official Gazette on March 4. The route will receive support from official programs for the structuring, management, and promotion of local tourist attractions.

item.title: Vice de Flávio terá missão de explorar caso Lulinha no Nordeste
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has nominated federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL) as his running mate and tasked him with leading the campaign in the Northeast, focusing on investigations into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) over alleged INSS fraud. The strategy aims to counter allegations linking Flávio to former banker Daniel Vorcaro by highlighting Gaspar’s role in the INSS CPMI as a counter-narrative. Allies hope to strengthen the association between Lula’s son and corruption schemes under STF investigation.

item.title: Bolsonaro pede autorização para visita de Flávio no dia dos pais
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro requested permission for him to receive visits from his sons Flávio, Carlos, and Renan on Father's Day (August 9, 2026), citing humanitarian and family reasons. The request follows a ban on visits imposed by Minister Alexandre de Moraes, who ruled that Bolsonaro violated house arrest measures by having a letter read by Flávio on social media, constituting indirect use of social media by third parties. The defense argues Bolsonaro did not authorize the letter's disclosure and that the senator acted independently.

item.title: Após três eleições com mulheres nas principais chapas, corrida presidencial de 2026 começa sem nenhuma vice feminina
item.description: The confirmation of Alfredo Gaspar as running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro marks the first time since 2014 that none of the leading presidential candidates in the 2026 election will have a woman as vice president, ending a streak of three consecutive elections with female representation on major tickets. The absence of women in vice-presidential slots reflects a setback in gender diversity within Brazil’s presidential races.

item.title: Vieira nega campanha de Lula contra Milei e chama fala de "descabida"
item.description: Brazil's Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira denied Argentine President Javier Milei's accusation that the Lula government financed Sergio Massa's 2023 election campaign with $1 billion, calling the claim 'absurd' and 'baseless'. Vieira stated that such an amount is incompatible with any electoral spending in Brazil and reaffirmed that Brazil does not interfere in foreign electoral processes.

item.title: Bolsonaro pede a Moraes autorização para receber visita dos filhos no Dia dos Pais
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's defense requested exceptional authorization from Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to allow visits from his sons Carlos, Jair Renan, and Flávio on Father's Day (June 9), following a 30- to 90-day suspension of visits due to judicial violations. The request emphasizes humanitarian and familial grounds, asserting that the visits will not interfere with the fulfillment of his sentence or precautionary measures.

item.title: Marcola ajudou lobista amiga de Lulinha a chegar à Saúde
item.description: Marcola, former Chief of Staff to Lula, informally received financial assistance from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, who paid his bills in exchange for access to authorities, including the Ministry of Health. The connection was facilitated by Lulinha and Renata, close friends of the lobbyist. Despite denying any health contracts with the 'INSS Careca', Marcola was removed from government in July after Lula learned of the situation, and Oswaldo Malatesta replaced him.

item.title: Justiça absolve fazendeiro acusado de ameaçar dar um tiro em Lula
item.description: The Federal Court of Pará acquitted farmer Arilson Strapasson, who was arrested in August 2023 on suspicion of threatening to kill President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The ruling was issued on May 8, 2026, following a review of the evidence presented in the case.

item.title: Foro de Lulinha é o mesmo dos condenados pelo 8 de janeiro
item.description: The debate centers on the appropriate judicial forum for trying Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, who is under investigation at the STF for suspected influence peddling. The question is whether he should be tried in a lower court or in the Supreme Federal Court, as is the case with those convicted in relation to the January 8 events. O Antagonista highlights the coincidence that the forum selected for Lulinha is the same one applied to defendants in the attacks on the seats of the Three Powers.

item.title: Alfredo Gaspar diz que candidatura à vice é nova missão contra o crime
item.description: Deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) stated that his candidacy for vice president, on the ticket with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), represents a continuation of his fight against organized crime and corruption. He made his first official comment on the nomination via social media.

item.title: Escolha de Gaspar abre caminho para Lira e Calheiros ao Senado de AL
item.description: The selection of Alfredo Gaspar as vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro’s ticket removed a strong contender from the Senate race in Alagoas, benefiting Arthur Lira, who now faces the conservative electorate without a major rival. Lira is expected to polarize the election with Renan Calheiros, seeking re-election with Lula’s support, while the MDB will field Dr. Wanderley for the second Senate seat and awaits JHC’s decision on the gubernatorial race.

item.title: Renan Santos diz que não vai cumprir decisões monocráticas do STF
item.description: Renan Santos, the presidential candidate from the Missão party, stated he would not comply with monocratic decisions of the STF if he deemed them illegal, particularly those encroaching on Legislative or Executive powers. He emphasized that he would only follow decisions made through due legal process and that unilateral rulings violating the Constitution should not be obeyed. Renan also said he would seek dialogue with the Court before defying a ruling, but refused to be a 'puppet' of the Judiciary.

item.title: Malafaia critica escolha de vice de Flávio Bolsonaro e defende outro nome para o posto
item.description: Silas Malafaia, a religious leader and supporter of Flávio Bolsonaro, criticized the selection of federal deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as vice-presidential candidate on Bolsonaro’s 2026 ticket, advocating for an alternative name. The criticism reflects internal negotiations within the Bolsonaro camp to define the presidential ticket. The content is subscriber-only.

item.title: Renan Santos diz que vai compor com 'parasitas e vagabundos' do centrão
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from the Missão party, referred to members of the 'centrão' as 'parasites and vagabonds' during a g1 and GloboNews interview, but stated he would negotiate with them if elected. The remark sparked controversy due to its harsh tone, though it signals a willingness to form political alliances.

item.title: Escolha de vice de Flávio pega integrantes da campanha de surpresa e desagrada aliados
item.description: The selection of Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) as vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) ticket surprised and disappointed campaign insiders, who had expected a woman for the role and criticize the allegations of rape of a minor and TCU irregularities against Gaspar, now being exploited by opponents. Despite claims that he aligns with public security, allies view the pick as questionable and lacking electoral value.

item.title: Filha de Clezão, morto na Papuda, quer ver Bolsonaro na domiciliar
item.description: Luiza Cunha, daughter of Cleriston Pereira da Cunha, known as Clezão, requested authorization from Minister Alexandre de Moraes to make a humanitarian visit to former President Jair Bolsonaro, who is currently under house arrest, to offer comfort following her father's death. Clezão died in November 2023 at the Papuda prison complex due to health complications linked to Covid-19, while being held preventively for his alleged involvement in the January 8, 2023 riots. Bolsonaro is serving a 27-year sentence for attempted coup and was granted house arrest in March.

item.title: Escolha de Alfredo Gaspar para vice de Flávio mira fragilidades do governo Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign selected Alfredo Gaspar as running mate after failing to secure a female candidate from the Centrão bloc. Gaspar, a former public security secretary and INSS CPI rapporteur, was chosen to directly challenge Lula's government on public safety, pension fraud, and to strengthen the party's foothold in the Northeast—a traditional PT stronghold. The move leverages ongoing investigations involving Lula's associates and family, while symbolically including female leaders in the announcement to mitigate the all-male ticket's impact.

item.title: Tarcísio tenta se afastar de duas marcas do bolsonarismo
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) sought to distance himself from two core tenets of Bolsonarism by stating he would no longer wear a cap in support of Donald Trump and reaffirming his trust in electronic voting machines. The remarks were made in an interview with RedeTV! on Tuesday, February 4. The move signals an effort to reposition himself politically ahead of the 2026 elections.
